record.dic_text:
02469 Chelday {khel-dah'-ee}

源自 02466; 陽性專有名詞

欽定本 - Heldai 2; 2

黑玳= "世間的"
1) 是大衛大有能力的戰士之一，也是每月例行在聖殿裡服侍的十二名首領之一  (#代上27:15|)
2) 與撒迦利亞同時間被擄歸回的人  (#亞6:10|)
record.edic_text:
02469 Chelday {khel-dah'-ee}

from 02466;; n pr m

AV - Heldai 2; 2

Heldai = "worldly"
1) one of David's mighty warriors and the 12th captain of the monthly
   courses for the temple service
2) a returning exile in the time of Zechariah
